Synthetic reference for fixed-source Academic CV. Go module revisions come from
starter 698fbb2d6828cb2dd6a71901b8b686b48143ab27; blox source is pinned by go.mod.
Use Hugo 0.169.0 extended, Go, npm ci --ignore-scripts, then Hugo --buildFuture.
Serve public at 127.0.0.1:4176. The system font pack is selected deliberately.
Compare / and /publications/example/ at 1280x900 and 390x900 with Firekylin preview
/academic-cv/index?academic=1 and /academic-cv/post?academic=1. The original reference
contains no cite.bib; native citation controls use an additional synthetic BibTeX
field in test/port-fixture.js. No borrowed author portrait or document is present.
